text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During summer camp, Kawakami Princess
is in
even higher spirits than usual.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, it's our summer camp
episode! You
know what that means,
right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's the turning point in our story! We're
about to begin a new arc, so I need to
train my body like
crazy to make sure I'm
ready!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With the Japanese Oaks behind us, all
that's left of the Tiara tour is the Shuka
Sho. And then
comes the real main event
of my classic year...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The battle to determine the true
princess among
princesses—the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A G1 race that we watched together
previously. The roster doesn't include
just classic-year Umamusume,
either—those in their senior year can
also vie for the Queen's throne.
choice_data_list: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After the brilliant sparkle of the Triple
Tiara, I'll have to compete against
queens both new and
old to see who
deserves this year's title.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect opportunity for me to go
out there
and prove I'm a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'll be celebrated by
everyone, just like
Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers and applause will become
my crown
of hope under which I'll shine
like a light.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And in the final scene, when I face off
against the Dark Princess, I'll take the
hand of my prince, Legendary Trainer,
and unleash my new special move,
United Ultra Light Beam!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll blast off into space, where I'll
run in the
upcoming movie!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Still...
I think it's an important
race on my
path to becoming a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Defeat is not an option! If I'm going to
enter, then
I have to claim first place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After all, a princess blows past all the
foes who
stand in her way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right! What should I start with?
choice_data_list: Then we gotta give training our al...
Then we'll have to work hard at tr...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-whaaat?!
choice_data_list: Cross the sea through sheer guts

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's from the latest episode of Mighty Muscle! Princess Fighter! Princess Fighter undergoes grueling special training to improve her kicking power so she can defeat a rampaging water dragon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hah! Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! There's already someone here?!
Look at
how she's thrusting her fists at
the waterfall basin.
What ferocity!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait—Akebono, it's you! Are you here
for some
special training, too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Nope, not training—I'm fishing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The freshwater fish here make the
perfect
ingredient for a delightfully
buono acqua
pazza. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to knock the fish out by
punching them
as they swim. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. So afterwards, you collect the
fish
suffering from concussions!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If they're only knocked out, that means
they're
still alive! They'll be just as fresh
as if they were
flopping around!
choice_data_list: Is there really a way to catch fis...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll help out too. These fish are about to
be
introduced to my kicks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash! Crash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess and Hishi Akebono
unleash their attacks into the water one
after another,
eventually knocking out
around ten fish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono cooks up the fish they
caught, and
the three of us enjoy a
scrumptious meal
together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: H-h-hold on!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's just like the red-hot training
episode from the first Princess Fighter
series! The hellish training session that
caused Legendary Trainer to see the
River Styx for an second!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are those goza mats floating on
the water?
What on earth...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's King! Are you here to try running
on water
too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing this special training where I
have to run
across the mats as they're
floating.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's your training?! Th-then... those two rows of mats there... Is one of them for me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, no. That one's for Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But I was just about to get some more
mats from the beach house for you! The
trick to running on water is to plant one
foot right before your other begins to
sink...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
D-don't trouble yourself! More
importantly...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer looks about ready to faint...
Are you
sure this is okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Trainer's only fallen into the
water
thirty times so far—right,
Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is the challenge from hell that we
must
overcome together! With grit and
guts, we won't
stop until it's finished!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Y-your trainer looks finished,
all right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I continue sprinting across the
water with Kawakami Princess until we're
able to successfully
complete the
challenge.
